env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Both orders build under the default limit. At a limit below the
# true chain, both orders must fail: reusing a cached instance still
# charges its subtree, even through an ordinary generic wrapper.
# Shapes c and d route Leaf through the ordinary generic Fwd; the
# true chain is 616 nodes in either visit order, so both fail at 460
# and both build at 632.
# Shapes e and f route Leaf through mutually recursive ordinary
# generics A and B; the true chain stays 616 nodes in either visit
# order, so both fail at the boundary 615 and both build at 616.
cd w
logos build ./...
! logos build -o $WORK/a.exe -gcflags=all=-logos.comptime_nodes=430 ./a
stderr 'comptime::node_limit'
! logos build -o $WORK/b.exe -gcflags=all=-logos.comptime_nodes=430 ./b
stderr 'comptime::node_limit'
! logos build -o $WORK/c.exe -gcflags=all=-logos.comptime_nodes=460 ./c
stderr 'comptime::node_limit'
! logos build -o $WORK/d.exe -gcflags=all=-logos.comptime_nodes=460 ./d
stderr 'comptime::node_limit'
logos build -o $WORK/c632.exe -gcflags=all=-logos.comptime_nodes=632 ./c
logos build -o $WORK/d632.exe -gcflags=all=-logos.comptime_nodes=632 ./d
! logos build -o $WORK/e.exe -gcflags=all=-logos.comptime_nodes=615 ./e
stderr 'comptime::node_limit'
! logos build -o $WORK/f.exe -gcflags=all=-logos.comptime_nodes=615 ./f
stderr 'comptime::node_limit'
logos build -o $WORK/e616.exe -gcflags=all=-logos.comptime_nodes=616 ./e
logos build -o $WORK/f616.exe -gcflags=all=-logos.comptime_nodes=616 ./f

-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/nodeorder

go 1.27

-- w/a/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"
)

type Wide struct {
	F0 int
	F1 int
	F2 int
	F3 int
	F4 int
	F5 int
	F6 int
	F7 int
	F8 int
	F9 int
	F10 int
	F11 int
	F12 int
	F13 int
	F14 int
	F15 int
	F16 int
	F17 int
	F18 int
	F19 int
	F20 int
	F21 int
	F22 int
	F23 int
	F24 int
	F25 int
	F26 int
	F27 int
	F28 int
	F29 int
}

func Leaf[T any]() int {
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		_ = f.Name
	}
	return 1
}

func Outer[T any]() int {
	const if comptime.IsStruct[T]() {
		return Leaf[T]() + 1
	}
	return 0
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(Leaf[Wide]())
	fmt.Println(Outer[Wide]())
}

package main

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"
)

type Wide struct {
	F0 int
	F1 int
	F2 int
	F3 int
	F4 int
	F5 int
	F6 int
	F7 int
	F8 int
	F9 int
	F10 int
	F11 int
	F12 int
	F13 int
	F14 int
	F15 int
	F16 int
	F17 int
	F18 int
	F19 int
	F20 int
	F21 int
	F22 int
	F23 int
	F24 int
	F25 int
	F26 int
	F27 int
	F28 int
	F29 int
}

func Leaf[T any]() int {
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		_ = f.Name
	}
	return 1
}

func A[T any]() int {
	return B[T]()
}

func B[T any]() int {
	return A[T]() + Leaf[T]()
}

func Outer[T any]() int {
	const if comptime.IsStruct[T]() {
	_ = 100
	_ = 101
	_ = 102
	_ = 103
	_ = 104
	_ = 105
	_ = 106
	_ = 107
	_ = 108
	_ = 109
	_ = 110
	_ = 111
	_ = 112
	_ = 113
	_ = 114
	_ = 115
	_ = 116
	_ = 117
	_ = 118
	_ = 119
	_ = 120
	_ = 121
	_ = 122
	_ = 123
	_ = 124
		return A[T]() + 1
	}
	return 0
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(B[Wide]())
	fmt.Println(Outer[Wide]())
}
